children: Pasithea Therapeutics announced its Nasdaq-listed warrants will expire on September 17, 2026 and be delisted.
Warrants to purchase common stock (Nasdaq: KTTAW) expire September 17, 2026 per the Warrant Agency Agreement.
Any unexercised warrants will become void and have no value after expiration, eliminating future exercisability.
Warrants will cease trading on Nasdaq and a Form 25 will be filed to delist and deregister them under Section 12(b).
Common stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol KTTA, unaffected by the warrants' removal.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
